confidence_rationale: HFO consensus is strong in LG8 and RC5, but seizure evidence is model-derived saliency proxy with no overlap with HFO channels; the cross-modal mismatch warning further limits confidence.

hfo_assessment.summary: Strong HFO consensus in LG8 and RC5; 52 ripples and 246 fast ripples detected across 89 epochs.

seizure_assessment.ictal_detection_summary: Two ictal candidate segments detected: 119.0–132.5 sec (13.5 sec duration) and 136.5–199.0 sec (62.5 sec duration), both with high mean and peak smoothed probabilities.
seizure_assessment.summary: Seizure evidence is model-derived saliency proxy; top supportive channels include RG1-RG2, RG2-RG3, RD3-RD4, RA2-RA3, RA1-RA2.

integration_assessment.summary: No direct channel overlap between HFO consensus channels and seizure supportive channels; cross-modal mismatch warning lowers confidence.

limitations: No overlap between HFO consensus channels and seizure supportive channels.
Seizure evidence is model-derived saliency proxy, not direct electrophysiological detection.

ez_hypothesis.summary: No concordance between HFO consensus and seizure evidence; hypothesis deferred pending further integration.
